description: Trafics routiers sur les routes départementales de la Drôme is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by La Drôme. Every year about 10 % of temporary counting stations are recorded. Each temporary station is measured regularly by prioritising roads by categories (1st, 2nd,...). Each year the value of all the sections is changed via a weighting of the traffic evolution of the associated permanent station (69 stations on the departmental network in 2020). Coverage: La Drôme. The portal shows the English title as "Road traffic on the departmental roads of the Drôme" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is La Drôme. Its keywords include trafic-routier, route-departementale. The listing shows 2022-12-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
